name: Discordant Solo: Vesper
summary: • When Discordant Solo is being attacked, the CRIT DMG of this attack decreases by 40%. When an Agent activates or extends an Ether Veil, the whole squad gains 1 stack of Sonic Resonance. Sonic Resonance stacks up to 3 times, and each stack increases Agent Anomaly Buildup Rate by 8% and Attribute Anomaly DMG by 15%.

appearances.performance:
• During the Control Skill, each successful counter against Discordant Solo's attacks grants 350 Performance Points.
• Performing a SHUTDOWN!! against Discordant Solo's Control Skill or countering the final hit of certain attacks and inflicting an IMPAIRED!! effect grants 750 Performance Points, up to a maximum of 5000 Performance Points.
appearances.misc: • Suitable for Agents with Anomaly specialty.
